observations: Photo 0: A black, cylindrical plastic drum with a white sticker on the side, standing on a concrete ground. Other containers (yellow, blue) are visible in the background.
Photo 1: Same black drum from a slightly different angle, showing more surface scratches and wear. The white sticker is still visible.

Photo 2: A blue drum stacked on top of another blue drum. The bottom drum has a white label with 'BIOCIDE' and hazard symbols. The top drum is partially visible. The setting appears to be an outdoor market or storage area.
Photo 3: Close-up of the blue drum's lid, showing a metal clamp and a black rubber seal. The drum surface has visible scratches and minor scuffs.

claims.claim: Commonly used for the industrial storage and transportation of liquids and chemicals.
claims.evidence: The blue drum in photo 2 has a 'BIOCIDE' label with hazard symbols, indicating it is for chemical storage. The black drum in photo 0 and 1 appears to be a similar industrial drum, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The drums may have internal damage or contamination from previous use, especially if they are not food-grade or have been used for hazardous chemicals.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the interior of the drums, showing the condition of the walls and any residue or cracks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially contaminated or unsafe for food-grade use

risks.risk: The drums may have structural weaknesses due to scratches, dents, or stress from stacking or handling.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full height and diameter of the drums, and a close-up of the seams and base to check for cracks or warping.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially compromised in structural integrity

risks.risk: The metal clamp on the blue drum (photo 3) may be loose or corroded, affecting seal integrity.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the clamp and seal, showing whether it is intact and properly tightened.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially leaking or not sealing securely

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the interior of both drums to check for contamination or damage.
Photo showing the full height and diameter of the drums to assess size and structural integrity.
Close-up of the metal clamp and seal on the blue drum to check for corrosion or looseness.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
